tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. A warm off-white that feels friendly, not clinical.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product photo windows, cards and inputs on surface.

tokens.name: surface-teal
tokens.usage: Soft teal panels for delivery, trust and platform notes.

tokens.name: surface-sun
tokens.usage: Warm highlight panel behind prices and promos.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface, surface-raised, surface-teal and surface-sun.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Specs and helper text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The logo orange. Primary button fill and big shapes. Carries on-orange text, never white.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on orange.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Orange text: prices, links and numbers on surface, surface-raised and surface-sun.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The logo green. Shapes and wave backgrounds only, never text.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and teal text on surface, surface-raised and surface-teal. Carries on-teal-deep.

tokens.name: on-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal-deep.

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Sale sticker fill. Always carries the word SALE or the percent off, never color alone.

tokens.name: on-sale
tokens.usage: Text on sale.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and ghost buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only.

tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with a 3px offset.
